name: ADP Payroll Services
description_en:
ADP Payroll Services is a family of payroll software and services rather than a single uniform plan. The reviewed US overview separates small-business payroll for 1–49 employees from mid- and large-business offerings, and links global payroll as a distinct route.

This draft examines the family boundary and the documented RUN Powered by ADP small-business packages in detail. Payroll processing, tax filing, employee access and general-ledger exports are documented, while time tracking, insurance, retirement and enhanced HR support have package or add-on conditions.
description_zh:
ADP Payroll Services 是工资软件及服务家族，并非一个统一套餐。所读美国总览区分 1–49 人小企业和中大型企业方案，全球工资另有入口。

本稿说明家族边界，并具体核对 RUN Powered by ADP 小企业套餐。文档列出工资、税务申报、员工访问及总账导出，工时、保险、退休和高级 HR 支持则有套餐或附加条件。

core_features.explanation_en: The US overview describes gross pay, deductions, payments and tax remittance, with RUN package details for small employers.
core_features.explanation_zh: 美国总览描述税前工资、扣款、付款及税款缴纳，并提供小雇主 RUN 套餐细节。

core_features.explanation_en: RUN lists employee access, pay documents, payroll reports, new-hire reporting and general-ledger interface.
core_features.explanation_zh: RUN 列出员工访问、工资文档、工资报表、新员工报告和总账接口。

core_features.name_zh: 按套餐提供 HR 支持
core_features.explanation_en: Enhanced adds functions such as SUI management; Complete adds basic HR support; HR Pro adds enhanced HR and talent tools.
core_features.explanation_zh: Enhanced 增加 SUI 管理等；Complete 增加基础 HR 支持；HR Pro 增加高级 HR 及人才工具。

pricing.summary_en: RUN quote varies with people paid, frequency and services; off-cycle runs and year-end contractor processing may add fees. Conditional credits are months 4–6 and 13–15, with Essential self-onboarding exception.
pricing.summary_zh: RUN 按付款人数、频率及服务报价，额外工资及承包人员年末处理可能加费。条件优惠在第 4–6 和 13–15 月抵扣，自助 Essential 例外。

sources.title: Payroll Services Made Easy | 1.1 Million Clients Trust ADP
sources.research_notes_en: Read US family split, payroll sequence, employee access, services and separate global/mid-large routes.

sources.title: Payroll Price and Plan Comparison | RUN Powered by ADP® for Small Businesses
sources.research_notes_en: Read RUN package/add-on distinctions, quote-based costs, frequency-dependent off-cycle fees, contractor bundle and cancellation FAQ.

sources.title: Limited Time Offer - Act Now and Save!
sources.research_notes_en: Read six non-consecutive free months, Nov 26 2026 start deadline, geographic/headcount/auto-debit conditions, Essential exception and excluded fees.

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Choose the payroll product for the employer
sections.title_zh: 按雇主情况选择工资产品
sections.en: The US overview describes 1–49 employee payroll separately from the 50–1,000+ employee route. Small-business RUN packages are Essential, Enhanced, Complete Payroll & HR Plus and HR Pro; the mid/large comparison uses different package names. These matrices should not be merged into one entitlement table. A multinational buyer should also use the separate global-payroll route rather than assume every US RUN feature and fee applies abroad. Before demonstration, define legal entities, worker types, locations, pay frequencies and the required level of outsourcing.
sections.zh: 美国总览将 1–49 人工资与 50–1,000 人以上入口区分。小企业 RUN 分 Essential、Enhanced、Complete Payroll & HR Plus、HR Pro，中大型方案使用不同套餐名，不能合并成一个权益表。跨国买家还需使用全球工资入口，不能假定美国 RUN 功能及费用全部适用于海外。演示前需明确实体、人员类别、地点、发薪频率及外包程度。

sections.title_en: Verify inputs, payments and accounting separately
sections.title_zh: 分别核对输入、付款及会计
sections.en: ADP’s overview describes gross-pay calculation, deductions, payment and payroll-tax processing. RUN’s matrix includes direct deposit, reporting, new-hire reporting and a general-ledger interface; the page gives QuickBooks, Xero and Wave as export examples. An illustrative parallel payroll could include regular hours, one bonus and one changed deduction, then compare employee net pay, tax liabilities, pay documents and ledger totals with the existing authoritative result. This is proposed acceptance guidance, not a completed run. Confirm funding cutoffs, correction or reversal handling and the supported accounting mapping in the actual service agreement.
sections.zh: ADP 总览描述税前计算、扣款、付款及工资税处理。RUN 对照表列出直接存款、报表、新员工报告和总账接口，并以 QuickBooks、Xero、Wave 作为导出示例。并行工资可包含正常工时、一笔奖金及一次扣款变更，再把实发、税负、工资文档和总账合计与既有权威结果比较。这是拟议验收，并非已完成工资。实际协议需明确资金截止、更正撤销及会计映射。

sections.title_en: Distinguish included payroll from optional services
sections.title_zh: 区分包含的工资与可选服务
sections.en: RUN Essential lists payroll, tax filing and employee access. Enhanced adds SUI management, job costing and related hiring/compliance functions. Complete adds HR helpdesk, handbook tools and HR records; HR Pro adds enhanced support, applicant tracking and learning-related tools. Time and Attendance, retirement, workers’ compensation and health insurance appear as add-ons across the packages. An employee app’s ability to show time data is not proof that the time-capture product is included. The contractor-payment bundle has its own monthly base plus per-contractor and year-end processing fees.
sections.zh: RUN Essential 列出工资、税务申报及员工访问。Enhanced 增加 SUI 管理、工作成本和相关招聘合规功能；Complete 增加 HR 服务台、手册工具和 HR 记录；HR Pro 增加高级支持、招聘跟踪和学习工具。工时考勤、退休、工伤险及健康险在各套餐中列为附加项。员工应用可显示工时，不证明已包含工时采集产品。承包人员付款组合另有月度基础费、逐人费和年末处理费。

sections.title_en: Obtain a quote that includes payroll frequency
sections.title_zh: 取得包含发薪频率的报价
sections.en: The reviewed pages publish quote requests rather than numeric RUN rates. The package FAQ says cost depends on payroll frequency, people paid and added services, and explicitly says off-schedule payroll increases fees. Do not assume unlimited runs at a fixed price. It says RUN services can be terminated at any time without a long-term contract, but that does not establish refund or data-export terms. Request regular and off-cycle processing, forms, filings, delivery, hardware, support and migration as explicit quote items. No sustained free plan or open-source license was established.
sections.zh: 所读页面提供询价而非 RUN 数值费率。套餐 FAQ 称费用取决于发薪频率、被付款人数和附加服务，并明确非正常计划工资会增加费用，不能假定固定价不限运行。页面称 RUN 无需长期合同、可随时终止，但未确立退款或导出条款。应分别询价正常及额外工资、表单、申报、交付、硬件、支持和迁移。本研究未确立长期免费套餐或开源许可。

sections.title_en: Six free months are non-consecutive and conditional
sections.title_zh: 六个月免费并非连续且有条件
sections.en: The specific promotion requires a signed sales order and payroll starting by November 26, 2026, continued processing and direct debit of fees. Eligible new RUN clients in the continental US with 1–49 employees receive credits in months 4–6 and 13–15, subject to good standing and stated conditions. Digitally self-onboarding Essential clients qualify for only three months. Non-payroll services, pass-through costs, off-cycle fees, hardware and other listed charges are excluded. This explains why a generic “up to six months” banner is not an immediate free trial or a permanent rate. Validate quote eligibility and reconcile imported employee and YTD data before cutover; no account, payroll, tax filing, payment or integration was tested. Regional service scope, hosting, recovery and complete exports remain unverified.
sections.zh: 具体优惠要求签署订单并在 2026 年 11 月 26 日前开始工资处理、持续运行且以直接扣款付费。美国本土 1–49 人符合资格的新 RUN 客户，在账户状态及条件满足时于第 4–6、13–15 月获得抵扣；数字自助入门的 Essential 客户仅三个月。非工资服务、代付成本、非周期费、硬件及其他列明项目排除。因此“最多六个月”不是立即免费试用或永久费率。切换前应确认优惠资格并核对导入员工及年内累计数据；未测试账户、工资、报税、付款或集成。地区范围、托管、恢复及完整导出仍未核实。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: No employee data import, payroll, tax filing, funding, promotion purchase or ledger integration was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行员工导入、工资、报税、供款、优惠购买或总账集成。

research_gaps.en: Specific contract, quote, product/country mapping, recovery, hosting and exports remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 具体合同、报价、产品国家对应、恢复、托管及导出未核实。
